description: Configuration for enhanced diff highlighting in screenshot comparisons

highlightModeDescription.content-only: Highlight only regions where content has changed
highlightModeDescription.position-only: Highlight only regions that shifted position without content change
highlightModeDescription.all: Highlight all differences including position shifts
highlightModeDescription.overlay: Apply semi-transparent color overlay to changed regions

description.verticalTolerance: Maximum vertical displacement (in pixels) to tolerate before flagging as change
description.horizontalTolerance: Maximum horizontal displacement (in pixels) to tolerate before flagging as change
description.minRegionHeight: Minimum height (in pixels) for a region to be analyzed
description.minRegionWidth: Minimum width (in pixels) for a region to be analyzed
description.similarityThreshold: Threshold (0-1) for considering content similar enough to be 'unchanged'
description.matchThreshold: Threshold (0-1) for matching regions between reference and target images

colorDescriptions.shift: Blue - Content moved without changes (position shift)

segmentationStrategyDescription.horizontal: Segment image into horizontal bands (simple, fast)
segmentationStrategyDescription.grid: Segment image into grid cells (more granular)
segmentationStrategyDescription.edge-detection: Use edge detection to identify content boundaries (more accurate)
segmentationStrategyDescription.color-clustering: Group similar colors to identify content blocks (adaptive)

methodDescription.ssim: Structural Similarity Index - Best for perceptual comparison
methodDescription.histogram: Color histogram comparison - Fast, good for layout detection
methodDescription.pixel: Direct pixel comparison - Most accurate for identical content
methodDescription.hybrid: Combination of methods for balanced results

annotationStyleDescription.detailed: Include labels, metrics, and change descriptions

experimental.description: Experimental features that may not be stable
